notes: גִּבּוֹר → *of a mighty man*: *of* under rule 19, supplied *a* and generic *man* under rules 15/46, headed on *mighty* by rule 31 subtraction.
כֵּן is the clause's predicate and carries the construction-supplied copula (*So are*) under rule 20; competing placement on בְּנֵי noted.
*the children of youth*: article on the anarthrously rendered rectum takes the fronted *the* (rule 29).
